entry.content:

The 8087 floating-point coprocessor uses a hybrid algorithm to compute the tangent function (FPTAN) with high speed and 64-bit accuracy. The approach combines the CORDIC algorithm for initial angle reduction with a Padé approximant—a rational polynomial—to compute the remaining small angle.

This specific implementation avoids slow division operations, enabling significantly faster computation than the 8086 microprocessor.

OrgWebAlchemy is a Guile Scheme library that uses Parsing Expression Grammars (PEG) to parse Org-mode documents into an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST). Leveraging the `(ice-9 peg)` module, the library converts Org markup into SXML and then renders it to HTML, enabling Org file exports without the Emacs editor.

The library handles complex structures including nested lists, tables, and various code blocks. The project is licensed under the GNU LGPL v3 and is planned for future packaging in GNU Guix as `guile-orgwebalchemy`.

entry.title: F-Droid Releases 2.0 Update with Redesigned Interface
entry.content:
Hacker News Best | f-droid.org | hacker news

F-Droid has announced the launch of version 2.0, its largest update in a decade, featuring a complete redesign of the application's interface. Built with Kotlin Compose, the update introduces a modernized UI, a simplified three-part navigation system—comprising Discover, Search, and My Apps—and improved app discovery through expanded categories and enhanced search functionality.

The release includes advanced filtering options, such as combining device compatibility with specific anti-features, and a streamlined installation process utilizing new Android APIs. F-Droid 2.0 also implements automatic background updates by default and provides updated privacy-focused "panic" features and Tor support.
